The selected sleeve fit must show sleeve-to-arm width/contact or separation over a useful exposed length.
Any adopted neckline relationship must show both garment edge and the relevant upper-body endpoint in-frame.
Place, immediate activity, its visible trace, and expression connect into a readable moment.
Face and short dark bob provide visible reference guidance without assigning an actual identity or biography.

strict_rule: Hidden, partial, unsupported, or unobservable selected fit relationships cannot pass. User judgment remains not_yet_received.
